approval: ok lets do this, we will review at each step but dont proceed without my approval

proposal.purpose: Determine whether bounded continuation materially improves base-language coherence; not a promise of conversation readiness.

recipe.engine: Native MLX BF16 compute with FP32 master weights, optimizer moments and gradient accumulation
recipe.optimizer: Resume existing AdamW state and original schedule; no restart, new warmup or learning-rate retuning
recipe.data: Existing native TinyStories train shards only; unchanged tokenizer; resume exact recorded stream cursor

budgets.evaluation_position_accounting: Count full processed prefix positions for autoregressive recomputation, not just generated tokens

estimate.basis: Conservative final-ten-minute measured throughput, on AC; 20% overhead allowance
estimate.deadline_includes: preflight, training, evaluation, save and report; stop early enough to save within deadline

evaluation.scope: Development diagnostics only; existing formal English gate unchanged
evaluation.validation: Fixed eligible heldout narrative windows; exclude train overlaps where identified, document unresolved native split leakage limitations
evaluation.story_decoding: temperature 0.7, top-p 0.9, one frozen seed/item; no best-of or selective regeneration
evaluation.reviewers: Primary agent manual review and GPT-6 Luna independently; disagreements fail conservatively. Not two human graders or final acceptance.
evaluation.holdouts: Do not use the prior eight unused future conversation probes or sealed acceptance material for training/selection

progress_gate_at_150M.failure: Stop at halfway; preserve failed evidence and checkpoint; no continuation to 300M

final_development_success.coherent_rubric: Grammar, topical continuity, entity consistency, causal/temporal consistency, local coherence each scored 0/1/2; total >=8/10, no zero, no premise contradiction or incoherent sentence. A trailing incomplete sentence at the fixed token cap alone is not failure.
final_development_success.degeneration: More than 20% repeated 4-word-gram occurrences after first occurrence, or any sentence repeated at least three times
final_development_success.interpretation: A successful narrative foundation milestone, not a passed broad-English or conversation gate

safety.nonfinite: Immediate stop on nonfinite loss, gradients, weights or optimizer state
safety.validation_regression: Stop if fixed validation NLL exceeds baseline by >0.20 nats at a scheduled check
safety.keep: Origin, latest recoverable checkpoint and three milestone checkpoints, with full optimizer/scheduler/data/RNG state and hashes
safety.correctness_failure: Terminal; no numerical tolerance changes or automatic retries

proposal.transition: Stop and report at the earliest hard stop, successful milestone, or budget boundary. No automatic conversation SFT or full reference run. Conversation training remains conditional on the existing formal English gate or an explicitly approved replacement, and separate training approval. TinyStories-only success cannot establish broad factual, web or tool capability.
